title: Sheila Jordan as a friend
summary: She likes Sheila Jordan, a good friend whose work is interesting.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: I‘ve also read . . . you‘ve cited Sheila Jordan before, as well. Is she an influence, or someone that you‘d say whose singing you just prefer?

Oh, I just like Sheila a lot. She‘s a good friend and what she does is interesting. I don‘t really, not understand it; I don‘t . . . well, what she does is very interesting. I mean, are you familiar with her work?
Yes. And she‘s a good friend. She‘s a funny lady. Yeah.
